package.name: open-agent-definitions-pi
package.description: Role prompt templates for the pi coding agent, generated from the grok/agents profiles.

code-reviewer-pro.argument-hint: <change set for a deep security and architecture review>

orchestrator.argument-hint: <task or MDU to decompose and delegate>

grok-4.7.text: Intended model xai/grok-4.7 — pi's default; no flag needed.

grok-build-0.1.text: Intended rung grok-build-0.1 (bulk). Verify with `--list-models`; if pi's xai catalog lacks it, run on the default xai/grok-4.7 and note the cost delta. Never block on model choice.

default.text: Intended model {model}; verify it with `--list-models` before relying on it.

constructs.label: Delegation, sub-agents, spawning, child sessions
constructs.rationale: pi has no sub-agent registry (clause 2). The role either performs the phase itself or hands the user a `/x <brief>` brief.

constructs.label: TodoWrite task lists
constructs.rationale: No TodoWrite tool exists (clause 1); track work in the response and durable notes instead.

constructs.label: Interactive question tool
constructs.rationale: pi has no question tool (clause 1). Ask in plain text and end the turn; never fabricate an answer.

constructs.label: Playwright MCP browser automation
constructs.rationale: MCP is opt-in via mcp.json (clause 4). With no Playwright server the profile's own BLOCKED discipline fires.

constructs.label: Blender MCP authoring
constructs.disposition: dropped (overlay-only MCP; no base profile references it)
constructs.rationale: Blender is an overlay-only personal server, absent from every base profile; nothing to port.

constructs.label: OpenCode environment variables and session ids
constructs.rationale: pi has no OpenCode env vars or session ids (clause 3); keep the checkpoint intent, drop the mechanics.

constructs.label: Keybindings, /compact, compaction and cache gates
constructs.rationale: Keybindings and /compact are harness mechanics (clause 3); the token-frugality intent still stands.

constructs.label: Shell allowlist and host permission mentions
constructs.rationale: pi allowlists are configuration, not approval (clause 1); the safety gate behind them ports as-is.

constructs.label: Model tier tables and model ids
constructs.rationale: Tier guidance survives as prose, but pi's xai catalog must be checked with `--list-models` before a tier is relied on.
